prompt.project_info: Create a cinematic equestrian fashion hero shot on a European historic street with a trained horse in a controlled rearing pose.
prompt.main_subject: Clearly adult fictional woman seated securely on a deep-black trained European horse, wearing a dark-red embroidered velvet-and-silk traditional-inspired ensemble with secure coverage, antique-style jewelry, calm regal expression, soft wavy hair and deep red lips.
prompt.composition_elements: Vertical 3:4 low-angle hero shot, cobblestone road, classic stone buildings, antique balconies and street lamps, horse and rider sharply focused against softly blurred background.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Natural cinematic side light, soft golden highlights, subtle fill and gentle rim light defining horse and rider, rich reds, deep blacks, warm highlights.
prompt.technical_specs: 50mm cinematic prime lens, shallow depth of field, slight mane motion, ultra-high-resolution photorealism, no text, logos or watermark.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Cinematic 3:4 equestrian fashion portrait of a clearly adult fictional woman seated securely on a deep-black trained European horse in a controlled rearing pose, dark-red embroidered velvet-and-silk traditional-inspired ensemble with secure coverage, antique-style jewelry, calm regal expression, historic European cobblestone street with stone buildings, balconies and old lamps, natural side light, warm highlights, 50mm cinematic lens, shallow depth of field, no text or logos.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, unsafe riding, horse distress, falling rider, child, teen, ageless person, celebrity likeness, public figure likeness, watermark, logo, text, distorted anatomy, extra limbs, deformed horse, graphic injury

assets.name: dark red equestrian reference
assets.source: Attach the supplied image as the visual reference.
assets.usage: Preserve horse rearing silhouette, dark-red embroidered outfit, jewelry, historic street, low-angle composition and lighting; keep identity, horse and architecture replaceable.

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Attach the reference image. Keep equestrian hero composition and outfit silhouette consistent, use a trained horse with safe handler-controlled staging and clearly adult fictional identity.

changes: Clarified adult fictional subject, trained horse and secure riding, and added explicit safeguards against distress or injury.
